strings.name: Fernando Alonso
strings.role: Racing driver · Two-time Formula 1 world champion
strings.summary: Alonso progressed from karting to single-seaters and won the 2005 and 2006 F1 drivers' titles with Renault. He later drove for McLaren, Ferrari, Alpine and Aston Martin. With Toyota teammates, he won Le Mans twice and the 2018–19 World Endurance Championship. His sustained international influence spans racing disciplines; in 2026 he confirmed another F1 season for 2027.
